decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system serves a niche defence market with long procurement cycles and rising German naval spending, so its results likely meet aspirations and the slack of a large firm lets it carry the product.

The C80-P G2 is a second-generation interior luminaire, an incremental update in the established core range; it has moved from its own page to a mention, but it fits existing routines and gives no clear shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The microprismatic pendant luminaire is still promoted as a latest release in 2024, so management sees it as performing at or above aspiration and will keep it.

The sister HMI searchlight was dropped, which suggests the marine searchlight portfolio was consolidated around this product; that makes F more likely to be kept as the remaining offering, though some risk remains.
